ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
<image>In $\odot X, A B=30, C D=30,$ and $m \widehat{C Z}=40$
Find $m\widehat{Y B}$
ready1_open_rewrite.title: Geometry3K open-ended question

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Describe the image: The figure is a circle with X as the center. Above there is chord AB, and radius/line segment XY points from the center X to Y on the circle, and is perpendicular to chord AB at M, with a right angle mark in the figure. At the lower right there is chord CD, and radius/line segment XZ points from the center X to Z on the circle, and is perpendicular to chord CD at N, also with a right angle mark. Reasoning: It is known that AB=30, CD=30, so equal chords in the same circle subtend equal minor arcs, that is, arc AB=arc CD. Because a radius drawn from the center perpendicular to a chord bisects that chord and the minor arc subtended by that chord, Z bisects minor arc CD. It is known that m arc CZ=40, therefore m arc CD=2×40=80. Thus m arc AB=80. Also because XY is perpendicular to chord AB, Y bisects minor arc AB, therefore m arc YB=80÷2=40.

method.method_draft: From the image, read that X is the center of the circle, XY is drawn from the center perpendicular to chord AB at M, and XZ is drawn from the center perpendicular to chord CD at N. From the text, use AB=30, CD=30, and m arc CZ=40. Since equal chords in the same circle subtend equal minor arcs, arc AB equals arc CD. Because a radius perpendicular to a chord bisects the chord and its intercepted minor arc, Z bisects minor arc CD, so arc CD=2·arc CZ=80. Therefore arc AB=80. The perpendicular radius XY bisects minor arc AB, so arc YB=80/2=40.
method.CoT_raw:
描述图像：图中是以 X 为圆心的圆。上方有弦 AB，半径/线段 XY 从圆心 X 指向圆上的 Y，并在 M 处与弦 AB 垂直，图中有直角标记。右下方有弦 CD，半径/线段 XZ 从圆心 X 指向圆上的 Z，并在 N 处与弦 CD 垂直，也有直角标记。
推理：已知 AB=30，CD=30，所以同圆中等弦所对的劣弧相等，即弧 AB=弧 CD。因为从圆心作垂直于弦的半径会平分该弦以及该弦所对的劣弧，所以 Z 平分劣弧 CD。已知 m弧CZ=40，因此 m弧CD=2×40=80。于是 m弧AB=80。又因为 XY 垂直弦 AB，所以 Y 平分劣弧 AB，因此 m弧YB=80÷2=40。

method.method_draft: From the image, read that XM is perpendicular to AB and XN is perpendicular to CD, with Y on the extension of XM to the circle and Z on the extension of XN to the circle. From the text, AB=CD=30. Since a perpendicular from the circle center to a chord bisects the chord, MB=ND=15. Radii XB and XD are equal, and triangles XMB and XND are right triangles, so they are congruent by hypotenuse-leg. Thus angle MXB equals angle NXD. Because M lies on ray XY and N lies on ray XZ, angle MXB is the central angle for arc YB, and angle NXD is the central angle for arc ZD. Also, since XZ is perpendicular to CD, it bisects arc CD, so arc ZD=arc CZ=40. Therefore arc YB=40.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是以 X 为圆心的圆。上方有弦 AB，点 M 在 AB 上，半径方向的线段 XY 经过 M，并且图中用直角标记表示 XM 垂直于 AB。右下方有弦 CD，点 N 在 CD 上，半径方向的线段 XZ 经过 N，并且图中用直角标记表示 XN 垂直于 CD。点 Y、Z 都在圆上。

推理：已知 AB=30，CD=30。圆心到弦的垂线平分弦，所以 MB=15，ND=15。XB 和 XD 都是同一个圆的半径，所以 XB=XD。三角形 XMB 和 XND 都是直角三角形，且斜边相等、对应直角边相等，因此由 HL 可知这两个三角形全等，所以 ∠MXB=∠NXD。因为 M 在射线 XY 上，N 在射线 XZ 上，所以 ∠MXB 是弧 YB 对应的圆心角，∠NXD 是弧 ZD 对应的圆心角，因此弧 YB 与弧 ZD 度数相等。又因为 XZ 垂直于 CD，所以它平分弧 CD，故弧 ZD=弧 CZ=40。于是 m弧YB=40。
